app.title: Holotype
app.startFailed.title: Holotype didn't start
app.startFailed.body: The plugin window couldn't reach Figma. Close the plugin, then run it again from Plugins ▸ Development ▸ Holotype.
tabs.label: Holotype sections
library.body: Soon you'll browse your Storybook components here and sync them in one click. For now, import a file that the Holotype CLI exported.
import.empty.title: Import a Holotype file
import.empty.body: Run npx holotype export in your Storybook project. It writes a .holotype.zip file that you can import here.
import.drop.label: Drop a .holotype.zip file here, or choose one.
import.loading.title: Reading {file}…
import.loading.body: Checking the file first. Nothing changes in Figma until it checks out.
import.error.title: This file can't be imported
import.error.APPLY_BUNDLE_CORRUPT: The file is damaged, incomplete or not a Holotype file. Export it again, then import the new file.
import.error.APPLY_BUNDLE_REJECTED: The file is larger than Holotype allows. Export fewer components at a time. If you didn't create this file, don't import it.
import.error.APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTE: This file was made by a Holotype version this plugin can't read. Update the plugin, or export the file again with a matching Holotype CLI.
import.error.APPLY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE: This file uses something this plugin version can't build yet ({features}). Update the plugin, or export the file without it.
import.error.APPLY_NO_EDIT_ACCESS: Holotype builds components. Open this file in Design mode with edit access.
import.success.title: File accepted
import.success.body: {components, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} with {variants, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} from {file}. Figma is building them now: follow along in Report.
report.empty.title: No report yet
report.empty.body: Import components to see what was created, and any warnings.
report.running.title: Importing components…
report.failed.title: Import stopped
report.done.title: {count, plural, one {# component imported} other {# components imported}}
report.done.variants: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} in {seconds} s
report.done.failed: {count, plural, one {# component failed. Run the import again to finish it.} other {# components failed. Run the import again to finish them.}}
report.cancelled.title: Import cancelled
report.cancelled.body: Finished components were kept. Run the import again to finish the rest.
report.messages: {count, plural, =0 {No warnings} one {# message} other {# messages}}
settings.body: Pairing, sources and import defaults will live here.
